title: Subset coordinates of the tuple total, differential and singleton restriction
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $X=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ [def-pc-scheme], $r\in\mathbb N$, and $f:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to A$. Put $V=\bigcup_iD(f_i)$ and $D_S=D(\prod_{j\in S}f_j)$. Let $J$ be an arbitrary unbounded complex of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], let $J'$ be its termwise restriction to $V$, and put $U_i=V\cap D(f_i)$ as opens of $V$. Let $T$ be a complex of $A$-modules and let $\tau_n:T^n\cong\prod_{\varnothing\ne S\subseteq\operatorname{Fin}(r)}\Gamma(D_S,J^{n+1-|S|})$ be degreewise $A$-linear isomorphisms. Assume the transported differential at $S$ is the sum of $(-1)^{|S|-1}d_J$ on the $S$ coordinate and, for each $j\in S$ with nonempty deletion, restriction of the $S\setminus\{j\}$ coordinate multiplied by $(-1)^{|\{i\in S:i<j\}|}$. The restriction inequalities $D_S\subseteq D_{S\setminus\{j\}}$ and $D_S\subseteq V$ for singleton $S$, and the equalities $n+1-|S\setminus\{j\}|=n+2-|S|$ and $n=n+1-|S|$ for singleton $S$, provide the transports appearing in these formulas. Let $B$ be the alternating increasing-tuple total complex of $J'$ for $U$ [def-sc-alternating-cech-total-complex], after forgetting scalar actions. There exist additive isomorphisms $b_n:T^n\cong B^n$ intertwining consecutive differentials. For every $s\in\Gamma(V,J^n)$, let $c_n(s)$ be the subset-coordinate function equal to restriction of $s$ on singleton subsets, with the indicated coefficient-degree transport, and zero otherwise. Then $b_n(\tau_n^{-1}(c_n(s)))$ is the degree-$n$ tuple augmentation applied to the canonical restriction-section transport of $s$ [lem-sc-principal-open-cech-section-transport].

source.place: Tag 08C1, equation (20.40.0.1), compatibility of the section augmentation with the alternating total; Tag 01FM, increasing-tuple convention. The coordinate verification is written by X2.

proof.text: Use the explicit finite-sum insertion map. Its bijectivity defines an additive isomorphism by AddEquiv.ofBijective (the inverse is uniquely determined). Compose this isomorphism with the forgotten tau components to obtain b_n.

Apply the computed differential of explicit insertion to tau_n(s). The assumed coordinate differential equation identifies the resulting coordinate function with tau_(n+1)(d_T(s)) by function extensionality. ConcreteCategory.hom_ext proves the consecutive chain relation.

In the augmentation expression, tau hom cancels tau inverse. Apply the singleton augmentation formula of the explicit insertion. This is precisely the required equality with the canonical section transport.
